title: Bram and the Contact
author: Edmund Ravensworth
blurb: Tamsin Nystrom, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
